commits.summary: Record the setup for the generated callers and observers brief
commits.body: Every one of the brief's 13 campaign cases (examples 445, 458, 466, 484; product-behaviour cases J06, J10, J14, J16, J17, J19; Commons IO #520; successor slots 06 and 09) was already prepared by earlier campaigns, so nothing was fetched. The setup checked every deployment artifact against its recorded digest at the path its reader resolves, checked every source worktree against its pinned commit and tree, and listed each pair's changed production files with blob ids. It re-ran each case's registered public observation on its original JVMs, read-only: every fresh result equals the committed receipt and agrees with the outcome the brief states. It extracted the successor slots' original jars from their signed packages and rebuilt jvmcontract, which predated the last lib/src change. No claims, examples, callers or library code were written, and no verification job was needed.
